name: stock-risk
title: Reduce SKU-A stock
sql: UPDATE inventory SET available = 3 WHERE sku = 'SKU-A'

name: unrelated
title: Change unrelated notes
sql: UPDATE orders SET notes = notes || ' updated' WHERE order_id = 'order-1001'

name: order-risk
title: Increase order-1002 quantity
sql: UPDATE orders SET quantity = 12 WHERE order_id = 'order-1002'

name: restore
title: Restore SKU-A stock
sql: UPDATE inventory SET available = 10 WHERE sku = 'SKU-A'

name: reenter
title: Reduce SKU-A stock again
sql: UPDATE inventory SET available = 2 WHERE sku = 'SKU-A'
